status.summary: IX.br documented active service at Elea SPO2 on November 25.

locator.precision: Census location of the former DXC pavilion on the acquired property. The exact footprint and expanded campus perimeter are unspecified.

locator.uncertainty_reason: The census gives a coordinate quality class but no measured horizontal accuracy for the establishment point.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked operator and project aliases, address, and named properties across 1,677 sites, 1,825 projects and all 231 entries in each imported-record, mapping and decision layer. The nearest prior geometry is ASAP SP1, São Paulo, 13,165 m away.
additions.successor_review: The operator distinguishes the acquired operating data center from its future campus expansion. The observation concerns existing operations only.

additions.name: Casey Data Park — proposed two-building campus

status.summary: On September 22, 2026, the Victorian Legislative Council recorded a petition concerning the proposed Clyde North data centre, application PA26-0190.

locator.method: Area-weighted centroid of the union of proposed Vicmap lots 12 and 13 on PS930476 in MGA zone 55, transformed to WGS84 and rounded to four decimal places.
locator.precision: Representative point for the proposed 16.2-hectare campus. The developer places both buildings on this portion of the larger property.
locator.identity_review: The KLM Spatial master plan locates the two buildings on the northwestern portion of the 53.2-hectare parent landholding. The union of the two corresponding proposed subdivision lots has an area of 16.24 hectares.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The proposal and cadastral records give no numerical horizontal accuracy for this representative campus point.

additions.distinctness_review: The proposed two buildings are a single campus. Neither the name, permit, applicant nor street address occurs in the snapshot 187 projects or their identity records. Vocus DC-MEL04 Mitcham is the nearest listed site, 32.4 km away.
additions.successor_review: The municipal register records further information on September 24. On October 30 the City of Casey said the application would be considered in December and distinguished estate-wide earthworks under a separate permit. The planning register still lists the assessment as in progress.

additions.name: Western Downs Digital Park — proposed four-building campus

status.summary: On November 18, 2026, Western Downs Regional Council recorded the applicant’s response to public submissions on the proposed campus at 1933 Dalby–Kogan Road.

locator.method: Centroid of Queensland cadastral Lot 125 on DY316 in GDA2020 / MGA zone 56, transformed to WGS84 and rounded to four decimal places.
locator.precision: Representative point on the 725.5-hectare primary property, inside the main proposed development footprint.
locator.identity_review: EPBC referral section 2.2.5 distinguishes the primary parcel from adjoining properties. The parcel centroid falls inside the central development area on the applicant’s Figure 2-2.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastre and project assessment give no surveyed positional accuracy for this representative campus point.

additions.distinctness_review: One campus spans four proposed buildings. The land, council application, developer and project name are distinct from prior sites. The nearest snapshot 187 site is NEXTDC B1 Brisbane Data Centre, 20 Wharf Street, Brisbane City, 214.0 km away.
additions.successor_review: A November 20 referral response was lodged on the council register. The material-change-of-use application was still in progress at review. A separate road-access decision covers that access only.

additions.name: Project Meridien — proposed data centre campus

status.summary: On November 12, 2026, the National Environmental Protection Agency reported that public consultation had closed on the proposed Meridien renewable energy hub and data centre.

locator.method: A whole-arcminute geographic grid intersection inside the labelled data-centre area in Figure 4, independently verified by registering the project boundary against the open federal referral polygon.
locator.precision: Representative point within the proposed data-centre area on the applicant’s conceptual layout. Individual buildings and the eventual campus boundaries are unresolved.
locator.identity_review: The applicant distinguishes the data centre from the wider renewable energy hub. The labelled block contains the selected grid intersection under both the printed graticule and a registration using five federal referral polygon corners.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The conceptual layout may change and supplies no surveyed campus boundary or accuracy for this representative point.

additions.distinctness_review: One commercial data-centre project is represented at the separate campus indicated on the Meridien project plan. The nearest snapshot 187 site is NEXTDC PH1 Port Hedland, 378.1 km away.
additions.successor_review: The recorded outcome of the October 21–November 4 public comment period is a referral-process notice. The federal referral remains under consideration. The applicant says detailed campus design and phase siting are still to be refined.
